text.en: Rain lashes against the stained glass windows of the Rusty Anchor Tavern. A cloaked figure pulls up a chair across from your table and slides an ancient silver coin between your fingers.
text.zh-Hans: 暴雨拍打着生锈锚酒馆的花窗玻璃。一个裹着厚斗篷的身影在你对面拉开椅子坐下，将一枚古老的银币推到了你的指尖前。

label.en: Welcome them to sit down and order a drink
label.zh-Hans: 热情招呼对方坐下并点杯麦酒

label.en: Keep your hand on your weapon and ask their name
label.zh-Hans: 按住剑柄冷眼询问对方来历

text.en: The stranger lowers their hood, revealing a warm smile. They unroll a weathered parchment map showing the forgotten sunken crypt beneath the harbor.
text.zh-Hans: 陌生人拉下兜帽，露出了温和的笑容。对方展开一份泛黄的羊皮纸地图，上面标注着港口下方被遗忘的沉没古墓。

label.en: Agree to explore the crypt together
label.zh-Hans: 答应一同前往古墓探险

label.en: Politely decline and leave the tavern
label.zh-Hans: 礼貌拒绝并收拾行囊离开

text.en: The stranger catches your gaze and flashes a royal crest hidden inside their cloak. 'Royal guards are scouring the district. Help me reach the docks, and your reward will be legendary.'
text.zh-Hans: 陌生人迎上你的目光，微微掀开斗篷露出皇室徽记：'城防卫兵正在挨家挨户搜查。帮我赶到码头，你将获得意想不到的酬劳。'

label.en: Lead them through the dark back alley
label.zh-Hans: 带对方穿过后巷避开守卫

label.en: Quietly alert the tavern guard at the door
label.zh-Hans: 悄悄向门口的守卫示意

text.en: Under the cover of howling wind and torrential rain, you navigate the cobblestone labyrinth of the old wharf. A hidden skiff rocks gently by the secret canal gate.
text.zh-Hans: 在呼啸的风雨掩护下，你们穿过了旧码头错综复杂的鹅卵石小巷。一艘隐秘的小船正在暗河闸门边轻轻摇晃。

label.en: Board the skiff and sail into the unknown
label.zh-Hans: 登上小船驶向未知的海域

text.en: The oars cut smoothly through the black water as the tavern lights fade into the mist. A legendary adventure has just begun.
text.zh-Hans: 船桨轻柔地划破黑沉的波涛，酒馆的昏黄灯火逐渐隐没在浓雾中。一段属于你们的传奇冒险就此启程。

text.en: You step outside into the cold rain alone. The storm washes away any trace of the stranger, leaving only ordinary tavern tales behind.
text.zh-Hans: 你独自推门走进冰冷的雨夜中。暴雨冲刷掉了一切踪迹，今夜发生的一切最终化作酒客们口中微不足道的传闻。
